Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Spruce collaborates with Ethereum Foundation, ENS and government pilots on privacy-preserving identity standards. The company emphasizes open standards, cryptographic verifiability and developer tooling over custodial identity. Backed by leading investors, Spruce advances self-sovereign identity research and interoperability. Its standards collaborations with ENS, Ethereum Foundation and government pilots advance verifiable credential adoption while preserving user control over selective disclosure. Expect a research and standards-driven culture that values privacy engineering, open collaboration and building durable, user-controlled identity rails for the ecosystem.

plasma.name: Plasma
plasma.description: Plasma, founded in 2024 by Paul Faecks and Christian Angermayer and headquartered in London, builds a high-throughput blockchain purpose-built for stablecoin payments. The network optimizes for low fees, fast finality and native issuance of USDT and other dollar stablecoins, with built-in compliance hooks, fiat ramps and treasury tooling for merchants and fintechs. Anchored to Bitcoin via periodic checkpoints and supporting pBTC, Plasma decouples consensus from payments execution to maintain predictable settlement under load. Headquartered in London with a distributed team across the US and Europe and backing from Founders Fund, Framework Ventures and Bitfinex, the project is advancing toward public mainnet and ecosystem partnerships with wallets and neobanks. Expect an execution-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory awareness and making stablecoin settlement as seamless as card processing.

open-standard.name: Open Standard
open-standard.description: Open Standard develops Open USD (OUSD), a stablecoin designed as open infrastructure for businesses moving money.

0x.name: 0x
0x.description: 0x, founded in 2017 by Will Warren and Amir Bandeali in San Francisco, develops open exchange infrastructure for Ethereum and EVM chains. Its product suite includes 0x Protocol for order settlement, 0x API and Tx Relay for aggregated swap routing and gasless execution, and on-chain RFQ via Periscope that power wallets like Coinbase Wallet, Robinhood Wallet and Matcha. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, 0x abstracts liquidity across decentralized exchanges behind a single API that handles routing, slippage and MEV protection for developers. Audited and governed as open infrastructure, 0x emphasizes performance, reliability and economic efficiency. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values routing correctness, developer experience and building invisible exchange rails that make trading feel simple and fair.

notabene.name: Notabene
notabene.description: Notabene, founded in 2020 by Pelle Brændgaard, Ania Lipinska and Andres Dupont with headquarters in New York, provides Travel Rule compliance infrastructure for crypto. Its platform, SafeTransact and dashboard, automates peer VASP discovery, secure data exchange and reconciliation that helps exchanges and wallets meet FATF Travel Rule obligations when transferring assets between institutions. Serving exchanges, custodians and banks across numerous jurisdictions, Notabene handles encrypted identity exchange, Sunrise assessments and reporting without exposing consumer data on-chain. Headquartered in New York with offices in Berlin and Lisbon, Notabene emphasizes interoperability, data privacy and regulator-ready audit trails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as SaaS rather than custody. Expect a compliance and privacy-focused culture that values secure data engineering, regulatory engagement and enabling institutions to transfer assets safely and compliantly.

kast.name: Kast
kast.description: Kast, founded in 2024 by a team of former Revolut and neobank operators with hubs in London and Singapore, builds a stablecoin-powered neobank and card for global consumers. Its product offers USD accounts, stablecoin holds and Visa spending with real-time on- and off-ramps, targeting freelancers and remote workers paid in USDC and USDT who need everyday dollar utility. Headquartered with a distributed team across Europe and Asia, Kast emphasizes compliant KYC, local payout rails and transparent fees while handling cross-border settlement behind the scenes. Still early-stage, the company focuses on card issuance, banking partnerships and mobile UX. The product roadmap adds multi-currency accounts, spend analytics and banking partnerships that expand practical utility for globally distributed freelancers and teams. Expect a product and compliance-focused culture that values payments reliability, customer support and making stablecoin dollars practically usable for daily spending.

orderly-network.name: Orderly Network
orderly-network.description: Orderly Network, founded in 2022 by Ran Yi and Terence Ng in collaboration with NEAR and WOO teams, provides an omnichain orderbook and liquidity layer for DeFi trading. Its infrastructure combines an off-chain orderbook for low-latency matching with on-chain settlement vaults across EVM and NEAR chains, letting brokers and dApps share deep liquidity without central custody. Ecosystem DEX frontends built on Orderly serve a high volume of trades with unified cross-chain margin and permissionless builder tooling. Backed by leading investors including Pantera, Orderly emphasizes composability for pro traders. Headquartered with a distributed team and core hubs across the Bahamas, Singapore and remote, the team moves at DeFi speed. Expect a builder-friendly culture focused on performance, risk engineering and empowering developers to launch trading venues quickly.

coinhako.name: Coinhako
coinhako.description: Coinhako, founded in 2014 by Yusho Liu and Gerry Eng in Singapore, operates a leading licensed crypto exchange for Singapore and the region. Regulated under Singapore's Payment Services Act with a Major Payment Institution license from MAS, it offers spot trading, staking and custody for retail and institutional clients with SGD rails and FAST transfers. Serving millions of verified users, Coinhako emphasizes local compliance, secure cold storage and straightforward mobile onboarding. Headquartered in Singapore with a regional team, it was among the first platforms to receive in-principle approval from MAS and holds additional registrations in ASEAN markets. Backed by leading investors including SBI and Saison, Coinhako focuses on sustainable growth. Expect a compliance-first culture that values operational discipline, customer support and building trusted access to crypto in Singapore.

relay.name: Relay
relay.description: Relay, founded in 2021 and headquartered in Wilmington, Delaware as Relay Link and formerly Reservoir, builds cross-chain payments and bridging infrastructure for instant token movement. Its protocol aggregates bridges and solvers to route user intents into single-click transfers that settle across Ethereum, L2s and Solana with minimal slippage and gas abstraction. Developers integrate Relay's API and widget to let users pay from any chain without manual bridging, custody or wrapped assets. Operating with a distributed team across the US, Relay emphasizes low-latency routing, solver economics and reliable settlement for wallets, marketplaces and consumer apps. The platform supports significant bridged volume through partner integrations. Expect a developer-centric culture focused on routing reliability, UX simplicity and helping builders hide chain complexity behind fast payments.

injective-labs.name: Injective Labs
injective-labs.description: Injective Labs is a research and development company building Web3 infrastructure and financial applications. It contributes to the Injective blockchain and products such as the Helix decentralized exchange.

nascent.name: Nascent
nascent.description: Nascent, founded in 2020 by Dan Elitzer and a small team in the US with offices in New York and San Francisco, operates as a crypto venture fund and builder collective that combines early-stage investing with technical building. The firm backs founders across DeFi, infrastructure and AI while contributing code, mechanism design and protocol research hands-on as a venture builder rather than a passive allocator. Headquartered with a distributed partnership across the US, Nascent emphasizes deep diligence, founder alignment and open-source contributions to portfolio projects. The team blends investing, engineering and cryptography expertise to support launches from research through mainnet and governance. Expect an intellectually curious culture that values builder empathy, rigorous evaluation and rolling up sleeves alongside founders to tackle hard technical problems.

trust-wallet.name: Trust Wallet
trust-wallet.description: Trust Wallet, originally founded in 2017 by Viktor Radchenko in San Francisco and acquired by Binance in 2018, is a leading self-custody, multichain wallet serving a broad global audience. Supporting numerous chains and a wide range of assets including EVM, Bitcoin, Solana and Cosmos, it offers in-app swaps, staking, WalletConnect and NFT management with no account or custody. Fully non-custodial and open-source, Trust Wallet emphasizes user ownership, security audits and browser extension plus mobile parity. Headquartered with hubs in Dubai and distributed globally under Binance's portfolio but operating independently, Trust Wallet is available in many languages. The product focuses on accessibility for newcomers and power for advanced users. Expect a user-first culture that values simplicity, security education and empowering individuals to manage crypto independently.

magic-eden.name: Magic Eden
magic-eden.description: Magic Eden, founded in 2021 by Jack Lu, Sidney Zhang, Zhuoxun Yin and Zhuojie Zhou in San Francisco, operates a leading multichain NFT and digital collectibles marketplace spanning Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin Ordinals. Its platform offers launchpad, aggregation, wallet and creator royalty tooling for trading, minting and managing collections with low fees and fast indexing. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed team, Magic Eden grew from a Solana-native marketplace to a cross-chain venue serving a broad collector base and thousands of creators. Emphasizing curation, discovery and pro-trader features, it supports both retail and professional workflows with mobile and API access. Backed by leading investors, it invests in marketplace infra and creator grants. Expect a fast-moving, marketplace-driven culture that values creator relationships, product iteration and reliable trading at NFT scale.

altitudedp.name: Altitude Development Partners
altitudedp.description: Altitude Development Partners is a venture studio, technology studio, and dedicated decentralized finance hedge fund founded in 2018. Built around systems engineering, quantitative research, and production-grade software delivery, the firm designs and executes systematic trading strategies across decentralized protocols and traditional financial markets. Altitude specializes in quantitative yield modeling, protocol and MEV analysis, liquidity dynamics, and automated risk systems, spanning from raw on-chain data pipelines to defended smart contract execution. Operating as a globally distributed team with high ownership standards, Altitude unites quantitative researchers, protocol engineers, and systems developers who build institutional DeFi and financial technology infrastructure.

sei-labs.name: Sei Labs
sei-labs.description: Sei Labs is the core developer of Sei Network, a high-throughput Layer 1 blockchain engineered specifically for digital asset trading, DEXs, and high-frequency Web3 applications. Featuring built-in order matching engines, sub-second finality, and parallelized EVM execution (Sei v2), Sei Labs brings Wall Street-grade trading speed to decentralized finance. Built with parallelized execution and specialized consensus mechanics, Sei Network delivers sub-second transaction finality and Wall Street-grade orderbook throughput for high-frequency Web3 trading applications. Sei Labs empowers developers to launch high-performance DEXs, perpetual futures markets, and gaming protocols with native EVM compatibility and built-in matching engines. Sei's architecture optimizes orderbook liquidity, sub-second execution, and high-concurrency smart contract throughput, bringing Wall Street-grade trading infrastructure to the Web3 ecosystem.

li-fi.name: LI.FI
li-fi.description: LI.FI provides liquidity and interoperability solutions for decentralized finance.

offchain-labs.name: Offchain Labs
offchain-labs.description: Offchain Labs, founded in 2018 in Princeton by Ed Felten, Steven Goldfeder and Harry Kalodner, builds Arbitrum, the leading Ethereum layer-2 scaling suite including Arbitrum One and Nova. Originating from Princeton research on optimistic rollups and fraud proofs, Arbitrum secures significant total value and powers much of layer-2 decentralized finance activity with low fees and Ethereum settlement. The company licenses technology from Princeton, employs rigorous systems engineering and ecosystem grants to expand developer adoption across custom Orbit Chains. Headquartered in Princeton and New York with remote colleagues, Offchain is backed by leading investors including Lightspeed and Pantera. The team blends academic rigor, distributed systems expertise and ecosystem growth to scale Ethereum without compromising security or developer experience for builders globally today.

blackbird-labs.name: Blackbird Labs
blackbird-labs.description: Blackbird Labs, founded in 2022 by Ben Leventhal, co-founder of Eater and Resy, in New York, builds consumer payments and loyalty infrastructure for restaurants using stablecoins and blockchain rails. Its products include Blackbird Pay for checkout, Flynet loyalty points and membership tools that let diners earn and redeem rewards across independent restaurants without interchange-heavy cards. Headquartered in New York with hubs in Los Angeles, Blackbird bridges hospitality operations with on-chain settlement, treasury and compliance behind familiar app UX. The platform targets restaurant operators seeking lower fees, direct relationships and data ownership. Backed by leading investors in hospitality and crypto, the team combines restaurant tech and Web3 expertise. Expect a product and partnership-driven culture that values hospitality craft, payments reliability and making blockchain invisible to everyday dining experiences.

openzeppelin.name: OpenZeppelin
openzeppelin.description: OpenZeppelin, founded in 2015 by Demian Brener and Manuel Araoz in the United States with a globally distributed team, defines the security standard for smart contract development. Its open-source Contracts library is the most widely used collection of audited Solidity primitives for tokens, governance and access control, while its Defender platform and audit practice secure mission-critical systems for leading DeFi protocols and financial institutions. Originally known as Zeppelin and founded in Buenos Aires, the company pioneered formal smart contract audits and education through Ethernaut. Headquartered in the United States with teams across 30+ countries, OpenZeppelin operates as a security-first product and services firm emphasizing research, formal verification and continuous monitoring. Its work underpins a significant share of value secured on Ethereum and L2s. Backed by leading investors, it advances open, reusable standards. Expect a rigorous, audit-minded culture that values code correctness, clear documentation and stewardship of shared infrastructure.

monad-foundation.name: Monad Foundation
monad-foundation.description: Monad Foundation, established in December 2024 to steward the Monad blockchain originally built by Monad Labs, supports the parallel EVM Layer 1 community. The Foundation administers grants, ecosystem programs and governance coordination independent of Monad Labs' commercial engineering, funding research on parallel execution, MonadBFT and EVM compatibility. Headquartered in George Town, Cayman Islands, with a globally distributed team and contributor hubs in New York, the Foundation coordinates testnet participation, validator programs and developer onboarding for DeFi and gaming builders migrating Ethereum contracts. The network targets high throughput and low gas fees without rewriting tooling. Governed as open infrastructure, it emphasizes decentralization and ecosystem neutrality. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on performance research, developer support and expanding practical infrastructure for demanding on-chain workloads.

braiins.name: Braiins
braiins.description: Braiins, founded in 2011 by Jan Capek and Pavel Moravec in Prague, develops Bitcoin mining software and fleet management around the legacy of Slush Pool, the first Bitcoin mining pool launched in 2010 by Marek Palatinus. Its products include Braiins Pool with Stratum V2, Braiins OS+ firmware for ASIC optimization, and Braiins Toolbox for monitoring and profit switching across large fleets. Headquartered in Prague with a globally distributed team, Braiins serves industrial miners optimizing uptime, efficiency and hashrate transparency since Bitcoin's early years. The firm pioneered open mining standards, Stratum protocol improvements and transparency dashboards after taking over Slush Pool operations in 2013. Operating as a miner-aligned company, it emphasizes firmware correctness and pool reliability over custodial services. Expect an engineering-driven culture that values Bitcoin openness, fleet performance and building practical tooling for professional mining operations at scale.

animoca-brands.name: Animoca Brands
animoca-brands.description: Animoca Brands, founded in 2014 by Yat Siu in Hong Kong, is a leading Web3 gaming, metaverse and digital property company. Through investments in a broad portfolio of companies and products including The Sandbox, Phantom Galaxies and Mocaverse, it champions digital ownership via NFTs and tokens. The firm operates publishing, advisory and investment arms that help studios launch token economies and marketplaces serving a wide player base. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Singapore, London and Sydney, Animoca blends game development, IP partnerships and on-chain infrastructure. Backed by leading investors including Temasek and Sequoia China, it advocates for an open metaverse. Expect a creative, entrepreneurial culture that values gaming craft, community ownership and building the infrastructure for an inclusive, player-owned internet today.

lightspark.name: Lightspark
lightspark.description: Lightspark, founded in 2022 by David Marcus, former Meta Novi lead, with a senior team from Meta, in Los Angeles, builds enterprise infrastructure for Bitcoin's Lightning Network. Its platform, Lightspark Predict and Lightspark Connect, offers node management, liquidity automation, routing optimization and compliant wallet SDKs that let exchanges, neobanks and wallets send instant low-fee bitcoin payments without operating Lightning directly. Headquartered in Los Angeles with hubs in Austin and remote, Lightspark integrates with banking rails, stablecoin issuance and compliance tooling to bring programmable money to mainstream apps. Backed by leading investors, the team applies consumer-scale payments expertise to Bitcoin. Its tools integrate compliance, risk and reporting that let banks launch compliant Lightning wallets, streaming payments and enterprise treasury flows. Expect a product and infrastructure culture that values reliability, regulatory thoughtfulness and extending Bitcoin for everyday global payments.

polygon-labs.name: Polygon Labs
polygon-labs.description: Polygon Labs, founded in 2017 as Matic Network by Sandeep Nailwal, Jaynti Kanani and Anurag Arjun in Mumbai and now headquartered in Dubai, London and New York, develops Ethereum scaling infrastructure. Its suite spans Polygon PoS, Polygon zkEVM and the AggLayer for aggregated liquidity, plus the Polygon CDK for builders launching sovereign ZK chains. Serving millions through wallets, DeFi and enterprise pilots including Starbucks and Adobe, Polygon emphasizes EVM equivalence, low fees and modular growth for mainstream adoption. Backed by leading investors and stewarded alongside the Polygon Foundation, the ecosystem funds grants, protocol upgrades and zero-knowledge research. The network is open and governed with contributors worldwide. Expect a builder-focused culture that values ecosystem collaboration, scaling pragmatism and helping developers ship affordable, Ethereum-aligned experiences at scale.

localcoin.name: Localcoin
localcoin.description: Localcoin operates one of North America's largest physical cryptocurrency ATM networks, providing thousands of retail kiosk locations across Canada and the United States. Localcoin enables everyday consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital assets instantly with physical cash through compliant, user-friendly terminals. Localcoin operates thousands of cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, giving everyday consumers a compliant physical gateway to trade digital assets. Localcoin enables retail users to buy and sell Bitcoin, Ethereum, and digital currencies instantly with cash through user-friendly retail kiosks integrated with local banking rails. Localcoin operates thousands of retail cash-to-crypto kiosk terminals across North America, providing a secure, compliant physical gateway for consumers to buy and sell Bitcoin.

morpho.name: Morpho
morpho.description: Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol on Ethereum and Base that optimizes interest rates for borrowers and lenders by matching supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave. Known for its permissionless Morpho Blue primitives and vault architecture, Morpho prioritizes formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency. Morpho Blue provides permissionless lending primitives that allow risk managers and DeFi protocols to deploy isolated lending markets with customizable collateral parameters and dynamic interest rate curves. Morpho matches supply and demand peer-to-peer while falling back on underlying liquidity pools like Compound and Aave, prioritizing formal verification, smart contract security, and capital efficiency.

shakepay.name: Shakepay
shakepay.description: Shakepay, founded in 2015 by Jean Amiouny and Roy Breidi in Montreal, operates Canada's leading consumer crypto app for buying, selling and paying with bitcoin and ether. Its products include Shakepay Wallet, recurring buys, bill pay, peer transfers and the Shakepay Card that lets users spend crypto balances at merchants with e-Transfer rails for CAD funding. Headquartered in Montreal with hubs in Toronto and remote across Canada, Shakepay emphasizes simple mobile UX, customer education and compliance under Canadian FINTRAC oversight rather than complex derivatives. Serving a broad retail base, the company navigates evolving regulation with a trust-first approach. Backed by growth capital, it focuses on reliable funding rails and support. Expect a customer-centric culture that values clarity, regulatory craft and expanding accessible, everyday crypto use for Canadians.

allium.name: Allium
allium.description: Allium, founded in 2021 by Ethan Chan and Cheng Han Lee, former engineering leaders at Meta and Primer, in New York, provides enterprise blockchain data infrastructure for institutions. Its platform ingests, normalizes and indexes data from numerous chains to deliver real-time analytics, compliance queries and warehouse-ready datasets for banks, fintechs and crypto firms. Clients use Allium to monitor stablecoin flows, decode smart contracts and power dashboards without running nodes. Backed by leading investors including Theory Ventures and Kleiner Perkins, Allium emphasizes data accuracy, low-latency pipelines and SQL accessibility for analysts. Headquartered in New York with a distributed engineering team, the company bridges Web2 data expectations with on-chain complexity. Expect a data-obsessed culture that values pipeline reliability, customer-driven product and turning raw blocks into actionable intelligence.

turnkey.name: Turnkey
turnkey.description: Turnkey, founded in 2022 by Bryce Ferguson and Jack Kearney, former Coinbase engineers, in New York, provides low-level wallet infrastructure for developers. Its API abstracts private key generation, signing and policy enforcement into secure, scalable enclaves, letting apps spin up millions of non-custodial wallets with flexible permissions, social recovery and session keys. Used by exchanges, fintechs and on-chain games, Turnkey emphasizes sub-100ms signing, audited cryptography and fine-grained policies without exposing raw keys. Backed by leading investors including Sequoia and Variant, the company focuses on invisible infrastructure that makes crypto UX feel like Web2. Headquartered in New York with a remote US team, Turnkey operates with deep security expertise. Expect a high-trust engineering culture focused on key management rigor, developer experience and reliable operations.

crypto-finance.name: Crypto Finance
crypto-finance.description: Crypto Finance, founded in 2017 by Jan Brzezek, Marc P. Bernegger and Tobias Reichmuth in Zug, delivers regulated institutional services for digital assets under Swiss FINMA oversight. As part of Deutsche Börse Group since its 2021 acquisition, it offers custody, staking, tokenization and brokerage for banks and professional investors via Crypto Storage AG and Crypto Brokerage. The group was among the first to receive a Swiss securities house license for crypto, enabling compliant access to trading and yield products. Headquartered in Zug with offices in Zurich, the firm connects traditional banking rails with on-chain settlement. Backed by Deutsche Börse and leading investors, it emphasizes audit, segregation and operational excellence. Expect a precise, compliance-first culture where engineers and risk teams collaborate closely with regulators and institutional clients.

airtm.name: Airtm
airtm.description: Airtm is a digital dollar account and cross-border payment platform serving over 1 million users across Latin America and emerging markets. Airtm enables freelancers, digital workers, and remote teams to receive payouts, hold USDC digital dollars, and cash out into local bank accounts with low fees. Airtm provides digital dollar accounts and cross-border payment rails for freelancers and remote workers in emerging markets, facilitating instant USDC payouts and bank settlement. Operating across Latin America and global markets, Airtm enables users to hold digital dollars, send payments, and convert funds into local bank accounts with minimal fees.

etoro.name: eToro
etoro.description: eToro, founded in 2007 in Tel Aviv by Yoni Assia with brothers Ronen Assia and David Ring as RetailFX, operates a social investing platform serving millions of registered users across many countries. The platform offers stocks, exchange-traded funds, crypto assets and copy trading that lets users replicate strategies of experienced investors, plus educational resources and community feeds. Regulated by authorities including the Financial Conduct Authority, CySEC and ASIC, and publicly listed on Nasdaq, eToro emphasizes transparent product design and responsible access to markets. Headquartered in Tel Aviv with hubs in London, Hoboken, Limassol and Sydney and operations across Europe and the Middle East, the company values community learning, behavioral insights and building collaborative investing experiences for retail and experienced traders alike.

ripio.name: Ripio
ripio.description: Ripio, founded in 2013 by Sebastián Serrano and Luciana Cavanagh in Buenos Aires, is one of Latin America's pioneer blockchain companies and leading digital asset platforms, serving over 10 million users across Argentina, Brazil, Colombia, Uruguay, Mexico, and Spain. Ripio develops a comprehensive ecosystem of consumer and enterprise Web3 products, including Ripio Wallet, Ripio Trade, the Ripio Card crypto-cashback debit card, Ripio B2B payment infrastructure, and LaChain, an Ethereum-compatible Layer-1 blockchain tailored for Latin American use cases. Backed by prominent global and regional investors such as Tim Draper, Digital Currency Group, and Marcos Galperin, Ripio pairs deep regional banking integrations with cutting-edge protocol development to drive mainstream crypto adoption across LATAM.

xapo-bank.name: Xapo Bank
xapo-bank.description: Xapo Bank, originally founded in 2013 as Xapo by Wences Casares in Palo Alto and now headquartered in Gibraltar, operates a licensed private bank integrating Bitcoin custody with traditional banking. As a Gibraltar-regulated bank and supervised VASP, it offers insured Bitcoin custody in underground vaults, interest on bitcoin and USD accounts with dedicated IBANs, plus card spending. Serving high-net-worth members and institutions globally, Xapo emphasizes security through deep cold storage, multi-party computation and inheritance planning. Licensed in Gibraltar with members across many countries, it bridges private banking discretion with Bitcoin conviction. Backed by leading investors including Greylock and Index, Xapo maintains a selective membership model. Expect a security-first culture that values privacy, long-term custody thinking and combining bank-grade compliance with Bitcoin-native product.

altitude.name: Altitude
altitude.description: Altitude is a global business account and financial operating system built on stablecoin rails, accessible from over 200 countries. Developed by Squads, Altitude provides businesses with USD and EUR operating accounts without requiring a US entity, corporate Visa cards with up to 2% cashback, global payments with multi-currency FX, automated bill pay, invoicing, and treasury management. Built on programmable, self-custodial smart accounts with multi-entity controls.

hedera.name: Hedera
hedera.description: Hedera is a public distributed ledger technology platform.

b2c2.name: B2C2
b2c2.description: B2C2, founded in 2015 by Max Boonen and Flavio Molendini in London, is a leading OTC market maker and single-dealer platform for digital assets. Acquired by SBI Financial Services, B2C2 provides spot, options, CFDs and electronic trading to institutions, exchanges and brokerages with deep liquidity across major pairs and stablecoins. Headquartered in London with hubs in New York, Tokyo and Jersey, B2C2 combines quantitative pricing, 24/7 risk and post-trade settlement that abstracts exchange fragmentation. Regulated as an OTC desk in the UK and expanding in the US and Japan, it serves hundreds of institutional clients. The firm emphasizes tight pricing, inventory discipline and reliable execution during volatility. Expect a markets-driven culture that values quantitative rigor, credit and settlement craft and operating as dependable liquidity rails for sophisticated traders.

dune.name: Dune
dune.description: Dune, founded in 2018 by Fredrik Haga and Mats Olsen in Oslo as Dune Analytics, provides the open blockchain analytics platform used by researchers and teams to query on-chain data. While the brand is often cited as Dune Analytics, the same team and product operate under Dune, offering SQL workspaces, dashboards, decoded tables and APIs across Ethereum, Solana, Polygon and dozens of chains without running nodes. The community has published open dashboards tracking DeFi, stablecoins and governance that are referenced widely by teams and media. Headquartered in Oslo with distributed hubs in New York and globally remote, Dune emphasizes data openness, collaborative forking and reliable pipelines. Expect a community-driven culture centered on data accuracy, documentation quality and empowering analysts to turn raw blocks into trusted intelligence for the ecosystem.

1inch.name: 1inch
1inch.description: 1inch Network (1inch.com) is a leading decentralized exchange (DEX) aggregator and Web3 ecosystem protocol engineered to discover the most efficient swap routes across decentralized liquidity sources. Powered by the 1inch Aggregation Protocol, Limit Order Protocol, and Fusion mode (intent-based gasless swaps), 1inch aggregates liquidity across Ethereum, BNB Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche, Base, and major Layer 2 networks. With over $400B+ in lifetime trading volume, 1inch offers retail traders, institutions, and Web3 developers deep liquidity, minimal slippage, MEV protection, and high-performance developer APIs.

woo-network.name: WOO Network
woo-network.description: WOO Network, founded in 2019 by Jack Tan and Mark Pimentel, with leadership from Ran Yi, and headquartered across the Cayman Islands, Taipei and Warsaw, builds deep liquidity infrastructure for CeFi and DeFi. Its ecosystem includes WOO X, a spot and perpetuals exchange, WOOFi, an omnichain DEX with cross-chain swaps, and liquidity provision that routes tight spreads from Kronos Research and external market makers. The network unifies trading, staking and ecosystem token WOO with fee sharing and institutional custody integrations. Headquartered with a globally distributed team, WOO emphasizes orderbook depth, low fees and cross-chain execution. The network invests in market making research, risk tooling and custody partnerships that sustain tight spreads and resilient settlement for active traders. Expect a trading-centric culture that values liquidity engineering, risk discipline and building venues that serve both retail and professional traders at scale.

securitize.name: Securitize
securitize.description: Securitize, founded in 2017 by Carlos Domingo in Miami, provides regulated tokenization infrastructure for private securities, funds and treasuries on public blockchains. As an SEC-registered transfer agent and broker-dealer, its platform handles issuance, KYC, cap table management and secondary trading for tokenized assets including BlackRock's BUIDL. Headquartered in Miami with offices in New York and globally distributed, Securitize bridges Wall Street administration with EVM and Solana settlement, emphasizing compliance, investor onboarding and lifecycle servicing. Its protocol integrations and fund administrator partnerships enable 24/7 transfer and on-chain accounting while meeting securities law. Backed by leading investors including major financial institutions, it focuses on institutional-grade workflows. Expect a compliance-first culture that values regulatory craft, transfer-agent rigor and building durable rails for tokenized capital markets.

fasset.name: Fasset
fasset.description: Fasset, founded in 2019 by Mohammad Raafi Hossain and Daniel Ahmed in Dubai and London, builds digital asset gateway and financial infrastructure tailored for emerging and frontier markets across the Middle East, Pakistan and Southeast Asia. Licensed by the Dubai Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) and financial authorities across Pakistan and the GCC, Fasset enables everyday consumers, diaspora remitters and institutions to invest, transfer and tokenize real-world assets with deep local banking integrations. Backed by prominent regional and global funds, the team emphasizes regulatory compliance, Sharia-compliant digital finance principles and low-cost remittance corridors. Expect a mission-driven, global culture centered on regional market expansion, payments craft and expanding digital asset access to underbanked populations.

tempo.name: Tempo
tempo.description: Tempo, incubated in 2025 with support from Stripe and Paradigm in San Francisco, builds a payments-focused blockchain optimized for stablecoin settlement. Designed for high-throughput, low-fee transfers with built-in compliance and fiat on- and off-ramps, Tempo aims to bring internet-native money movement to merchants, platforms and fintechs. Its protocol emphasizes predictable fees, fast finality and developer tools for treasury, payouts and cross-border flows without exposing end users to chain complexity. Still early-stage, the project draws on deep payments and cryptography expertise from its backers and founding team. Headquartered in San Francisco with a small, senior engineering team, Tempo operates with startup urgency. Expect a craft-oriented, privacy-conscious culture centered on reliability, regulatory awareness and making stablecoin payments as simple as card processing.

category-labs.name: Category Labs
category-labs.description: Category Labs, founded in 2022 by a small research collective with hubs in New York and San Francisco and closely associated with Monad ecosystem development, builds foundational research and tooling for high-performance blockchains. Operating as an early contributor group alongside Monad Labs, Category focuses on parallel execution, consensus optimization and formal verification for next-generation EVM networks. Headquartered with a distributed research team, Category contributes open-source libraries, testnet tooling and mechanism studies that inform Monad and broader EVM scaling efforts. The team blends academic research with shipping production chain upgrades. Governed as a builder collective rather than a custodial company, it emphasizes peer review and reproducible benchmarks. Expect a research-intensive culture that values distributed systems rigor, measured performance and collaborative advancement of scalable EVM infrastructure.

gauntlet.name: Gauntlet
gauntlet.description: Gauntlet, founded in 2018 by Tarun Chitra, a former D. E. Shaw researcher, with Rei Chiang and John Morrow in New York, provides quantitative risk management and optimization for DeFi protocols. Its simulation platform models market, liquidity and liquidation risk to recommend parameter changes for lenders including Aave, Compound and Uniswap, protecting billions in TVL with data-driven proposals. Using agent-based simulations and formal methods, Gauntlet acts as an independent risk partner for DAOs and foundations. Headquartered in New York with a distributed research team, Gauntlet is backed by leading investors including Paradigm and Ribbit. The team blends finance, engineering and data science. Expect an analytical culture that prizes rigorous modeling, clear communication with governance communities and accountable stewardship of protocol risk.

ckba.name: CKBA
ckba.description: Common Knowledge Base Association (CKBA) is a Swiss membership-based, non-profit association governed by its contributors, dedicated to supporting the development, open-source infrastructure, and ecosystem growth of the CKB blockchain.

anza.name: Anza
anza.description: Anza, founded in 2024 as an independent spinout from Solana Labs by former core engineers in San Francisco, stewards core Solana protocol development including the Agave validator client. Formed to decentralize client development alongside Firedancer and Jito, Anza focuses on networking, runtime, consensus and performance improvements for the Solana network. Headquartered in San Francisco with a distributed engineering team, the firm was created with backing from Solana ecosystem stakeholders to ensure long-term protocol resilience and client diversity. Its work includes feature activation, testing and validator tooling used by the global validator set running mainnet. Operating as a research and engineering lab, Anza contributes open-source upgrades and performance research. Expect a low-level systems culture that prizes protocol correctness, validator empathy and shipping careful, high-impact changes for a live high-throughput network.

tools-for-humanity.name: Tools for Humanity
tools-for-humanity.description: Tools for Humanity, founded in 2019 in San Francisco by Sam Altman, Alex Blania and Max Novendstern, builds World, formerly Worldcoin, centered on World ID proof of personhood via the Orb hardware device and the WLD token. The project aims to distinguish humans from AI online while preserving privacy through zero-knowledge proofs and broad global distribution. Adopted by millions of verified humans across many countries, World combines biometric hardware, privacy research and blockchain issuance with a consumer World App for payments and identity. Backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz and Khosla Ventures, the organization operates hardware manufacturing and operator logistics at unusual scale. Headquartered in San Francisco and Berlin with hubs in Munich and Erlangen, the culture blends product, privacy engineering and global operations with careful rollout.

hex-trust.name: Hex Trust
hex-trust.description: Hex Trust, founded in 2018 by Alessio Quaglini and Rafal Czerniawski in Hong Kong, provides licensed digital asset custody, staking and markets services for institutions. As a fully licensed custodian in Hong Kong and Dubai and registered in Europe, it offers bank-grade vaults, MPC wallets and compliance tooling for banks, funds and corporates holding crypto and tokenized assets. Its Hex Safe platform supports numerous chains and integrates DeFi, NFT and settlement workflows with insurance coverage. Backed by leading investors including Animoca Brands and SBI, Hex Trust bridges traditional finance and on-chain infrastructure with a focus on regulation. Headquartered in Hong Kong with offices in Dubai, Singapore and across Europe. Expect a security-focused culture that values licensing craft, operational rigor and building trusted rails for institutional adoption.

sphere.name: Sphere
sphere.description: Sphere is an end-to-end crypto payments and billing infrastructure platform built on Solana, enabling businesses worldwide to accept stablecoins (USDC, EURC) with instant settlement and automated invoicing. Often described as the Stripe for Web3, Sphere offers payment links, developer SDKs, recurring subscriptions, on/off ramps, and automated tax accounting. Backed by leading fintech and crypto investors, Sphere combines developer-first documentation, high-speed payment processing, and rigorous compliance engineering. Sphere provides developer-friendly payment APIs, on-ramp integrations, and automated invoicing tools built on Solana, simplifying stablecoin checkout for internet businesses. Sphere simplifies stablecoin payments for internet businesses, providing developer-friendly APIs, on-ramp connectivity, and automated invoicing tools built on Solana.

bcb-group.name: BCB Group
bcb-group.description: BCB Group, founded in 2019 by Oliver von Landsberg-Sadie and team in London, provides enterprise payments and trading infrastructure bridging crypto and fiat. Its core products, BCB Prime Services, BLINC instant settlement and treasury accounts, let crypto firms, market makers and fintechs hold, convert and move funds across GBP, EUR, USD and stablecoins with regulated payment rails. Headquartered in London with hubs in Paris and remote, BCB is authorized as a payments institution and serves institutions needing compliant banking access that traditional banks often avoid. The firm emphasizes settlement speed, reconciliation and auditability across banking and chain rails. Backed by leading investors, it operates as market infrastructure. Expect an operations and compliance-driven culture that values payments reliability, regulatory craft and enabling institutions to move value between banking and crypto seamlessly.

codex.name: Codex
codex.description: Codex, based in San Francisco, builds modern programmatic stablecoin settlement rails and cross-border treasury infrastructure for global internet businesses. Codex replaces slow legacy correspondent banking networks with real-time, low-cost digital dollar transactions (USDC, USDT), enabling marketplaces, software platforms, and global enterprises to invoice, collect, and settle payments worldwide with automated domestic bank off-ramps.

brale.name: Brale
brale.description: Brale is a regulated financial technology platform and licensed stablecoin issuer enabling businesses, fintechs, and financial institutions to create, deploy, and manage custom stablecoins backed by fiat and US Treasuries across multiple blockchain networks. Brale enables institutions and fintechs to issue, manage, and settle custom fiat-backed stablecoins across major blockchain networks with strict regulatory compliance. Operating as a licensed financial technology platform, Brale provides tokenization APIs, reserve auditability, and Treasury-backed asset issuance. Brale powers enterprise stablecoin liquidity and programmable fiat asset management for institutional digital finance.

bitbank.name: bitbank
bitbank.description: bitbank operates a cryptocurrency exchange in Japan. It provides yen-denominated spot trading, crypto lending, and APIs for market data and trading, with additional services for business customers.

walrus-foundation.name: Walrus Foundation
walrus-foundation.description: Walrus Foundation, established in 2024 to steward Walrus, is a decentralized storage and data availability protocol originally incubated by Mysten Labs, core builders of Sui in Zug and Palo Alto. Walrus decouples blob storage from computation, offering high-throughput, low-cost storage for large files, checkpoints and rollup data secured by delegated proof-of-stake. The Foundation, headquartered in Zug with global contributors, administers grants, validator programs and ecosystem growth independent of Mysten while coordinating upgrades and token governance. Emphasizing verifiable replication and erasure coding, Walrus targets AI, gaming and archiving workloads that exceed typical chain storage limits. Governed as open infrastructure, it supports Sui-native integrations and cross-chain tooling. Expect a collaborative, ecosystem-focused culture centered on storage reliability, open development and expanding practical decentralized infrastructure for data-intensive builders.

ellipsis-labs.name: Ellipsis Labs
ellipsis-labs.description: Ellipsis Labs, founded in 2023 by Eugene Chen and Jarry Xiao, ex-Citadel and Berkeley engineers, in New York, builds high-performance DeFi on Solana. Its flagship product Phoenix is an open, non-custodial limit orderbook DEX with on-chain settlement and instant finality, designed for professional market makers and retail traders seeking transparent liquidity. Complemented by Atlas, its validator infrastructure, Ellipsis focuses on low-latency, capital-efficient trading without intermediaries. Backed by leading investors including Paradigm and Electric Capital, the team applies traditional finance market structure expertise to on-chain venues. Headquartered in New York with a lean engineering team, Ellipsis emphasizes correctness and speed. Expect a rigorous, performance-obsessed culture that values market microstructure knowledge, security and shipping reliable trading systems in volatile markets every day.

veda.name: Veda
veda.description: Veda, founded in 2024 by Sun Raghupathi and collaborators in New York, builds institutional vault infrastructure for DeFi yield. Its platform, Veda Vaults, abstracts cross-chain staking, restaking and DeFi strategies behind tokenized vaults that handle rebalancing, risk management and accounting for fintechs and asset managers. Designed to let apps offer yield without running keeper infrastructure, Veda integrates with custodians, bridges and protocols while preserving non-custodial controls and audited strategies. Headquartered in New York with a distributed team, Veda operates at the intersection of DeFi and traditional asset management, emphasizing operational safety, liquidity and transparent reporting. Early deployments power vaults across Ethereum and L2s for a growing partner base. Expect a risk-aware, product-focused culture that values DeFi composability, institutional reliability and simplifying yield delivery for builders and allocators.

primexbt.name: PrimeXBT
primexbt.description: PrimeXBT, founded in 2018 in Victoria, Seychelles, is an established cryptocurrency and synthetic derivatives trading exchange serving global retail and institutional traders. The platform offers spot digital asset trading, margin perpetual futures, copy trading engines, and cross-asset liquidity within a single unified trading account. PrimeXBT emphasizes institutional liquidity integration, multi-signature cold storage custody, low-latency execution, and comprehensive technical analysis suites for active crypto traders.

horizen-labs.name: Horizen Labs
horizen-labs.description: Horizen Labs, founded in 2019 by Rob Viglione and team in New York, builds enterprise-grade modular blockchain architecture, Layer 3 rollup infrastructure, and zero-knowledge cryptographic systems. The studio was instrumental in developing ApeChain, custom ZK-verification layers, and modular EVM rollup networks for global brands, gaming ecosystems, and decentralized communities. Horizen Labs combines deep research in zero-knowledge SNARKs with production-grade blockchain developer tooling to make scalable, customizable, and verifiable computation accessible to Web3 builders.

alliance-dao.name: Alliance DAO
alliance-dao.description: Alliance DAO, founded by Imran Khan and Qiao Wang, is the leading global Web3 accelerator, incubator, and founder community, having backed 200+ top decentralized startups. Providing 12-week intensive cohorts, hands-on tokenomics design, regulatory advisory, liquidity coordination, and a global founder network, Alliance is the launchpad for high-growth crypto founders. Culture values deep crypto-native insight, founder empathy, analytical rigor, and building enduring open web protocols. Alliance DAO provides intensive mentorship, tokenomics advisory, and founder network access to early-stage crypto startups, serving as a premier launchpad for Web3 founders.

blockworks.name: Blockworks
blockworks.description: Blockworks, founded in 2018 by Michael Ippolito, Jason Yanowitz and Garrett Harper in New York, is a media, events and research company for crypto and financial institutions. Its portfolio includes news and podcasts, Blockworks Research and ETF analytics, plus flagship conferences like Permissionless and DAS that convene thousands of builders and allocators. Headquartered in New York with hubs in London and remote, Blockworks monetizes through subscriptions, sponsorship and institutional data rather than token issuance. It serves a broad audience of investors, founders and policymakers seeking credible coverage and market intelligence. Backed by growth capital and industry partnerships, it emphasizes editorial independence and data-driven insights. Expect a fast-paced, editorial-driven culture that values curiosity, audience understanding and building trusted information infrastructure for the maturing crypto economy.

telcoin.name: Telcoin
telcoin.description: Telcoin is revolutionizing global finance by uniting blockchain technology, digital banking, and telecommunications into a compliant Internet of Money. Founded in 2017 and headquartered between Los Angeles and Singapore, Telcoin operates Telcoin Digital Asset Bank (TDAB), a Nebraska-chartered Digital Asset Depository Institution (DADI) that connects traditional bank accounts directly to bank-issued eUSD Digital Cash and stablecoin rails. The company offers the self-custodial Telcoin Wallet, low-cost global remittances to over 40 mobile money platforms in 20+ countries, and the Telcoin Network, an EVM-compatible layer 1 blockchain secured and validated by GSMA mobile network operators.

immutable.name: Immutable
immutable.description: Immutable, founded in 2018 by James Ferguson, Robbie Ferguson and Alex Connolly in Sydney, builds Web3 gaming infrastructure including Immutable X and Immutable zkEVM for Ethereum scaling. Its products provide gas-free minting, orderbook liquidity and passport wallets that let games onboard players without exposing chain complexity, powering titles including Gods Unchained and Guild of Guardians. Headquartered in Sydney with hubs in Singapore and Los Angeles, Immutable emphasizes gaming-grade UX, carbon-conscious scaling and partnerships with studios and marketplaces. The platform handles significant in-game asset volume via StarkEx and ZK rollup technology developed with StarkWare. Backed by leading investors, Immutable funds developer grants and publishes research on game economies. Expect a game-first culture that values player experience, economy design and shipping reliable scaling for mainstream gaming adoption.

proto-xyz.name: Proto
proto-xyz.description: Proto is a decentralized consumer intelligence and spatial data network built on Solana. By leveraging mobile devices and community-driven verification, Proto empowers individuals around the world to map, audit, and collect localized urban, foot-traffic, and retail commerce data in exchange for tokenized incentives. Operating as a decentralized physical infrastructure network (DePIN), Proto replaces opaque, centralized consumer research monopolies with real-time, tamper-proof onchain datasets. Its protocol enables developers, consumer brands, and urban planners to query hyper-local market intelligence verified by thousands of global contributors.

r3.name: R3
r3.description: R3 is a leading enterprise distributed ledger technology and digital solutions firm behind Corda, a permissioned, scalable DLT platform purpose-built for regulated financial institutions. R3 works with central banks, global exchanges, tier-one banks, and asset managers to power central bank digital currencies (CBDCs), tokenized deposits, bond issuance, and cross-border settlement. Headquartered in London with offices in New York, Singapore, and São Paulo, R3 values financial regulatory compliance, enterprise software engineering, and institutional infrastructure. R3's Corda platform enables central banks and tier-one financial institutions to tokenized assets, deploy CBDCs, and automate cross-border settlement with enterprise-grade regulatory compliance.

very.name: Very
very.description: Very has 1 active role listed on Hashtag Web3. Current openings include Head of Business Development. Listed locations include Onsite · San Francisco, NY.

fomo.name: Fomo
fomo.description: Fomo is a Web3 social trading and liquidity discovery platform designed to provide real-time token tracking, copy-trading tools, and community sentiment analysis for crypto traders.

p2p-org.name: P2P.org
p2p-org.description: P2P.org, founded in 2018 by a team of validators and staking researchers with headquarters in the Cayman Islands and operations in Lisbon and Dubai, provides non-custodial staking infrastructure for institutions. Its platform supports dedicated validators, restaking and yield products across Ethereum, Cosmos, Solana and 30+ networks, handling key management, monitoring and performance reporting without taking custody. Serving exchanges, custodians and funds staking significant assets, P2P.org emphasizes uptime, slashing protection and transparent rewards distribution. Headquartered with a distributed global team, the firm operates bare-metal and cloud validators with SOC-audited processes. The team blends protocol research with 24/7 operations. The platform provides dashboards, alerting and governance participation services that simplify operations for funds staking significant assets across diverse networks. Expect an operations-focused culture that values validator reliability, security discipline and helping institutions earn sustainable staking yield with institutional controls.

temporal.name: Temporal
temporal.description: Temporal is a high-throughput decentralized exchange and liquidity protocol engineered for sub-second execution, MEV protection, and capital-efficient digital asset trading.

wintermute.name: Wintermute
wintermute.description: Wintermute, founded in 2017 in London by Evgeny Gaevoy with Harro Mantel and Yoann Turpin, is a global algorithmic trading firm and liquidity provider active on dozens of centralized and decentralized exchanges. The firm makes markets, provides over-the-counter trading and runs Wintermute Ventures for early-stage Web3 investing, plus on-chain trading through Bebop. Known for quantitative sophistication and continuous risk management, Wintermute offers deep liquidity for spot and derivatives with price discovery across fragmented venues. Headquartered in London with offices in Singapore and New York and a distributed engineering team, the firm emphasizes reliable execution in volatile markets. The culture is flat, engineering-driven and focused on disciplined treasury management, research and building resilient trading systems for institutions and protocols worldwide today.

ava-labs.name: Ava Labs
ava-labs.description: Ava Labs, founded in 2018 by Emin Gün Sirer, Kevin Sekniqi and Maofan Ted Yin at Cornell and headquartered in Brooklyn and New York, is the core developer of Avalanche. The platform uses Snowman consensus for sub-second finality and high throughput, powering a primary network with distinct X, P and C chains and customizable L1s formerly called subnets for enterprise and gaming deployments. Ava Labs builds developer tooling, bridging and institutional solutions including Avalanche Vista and AvaCloud for managed chains. Backed by leading investors and serving millions through ecosystem wallets and DeFi apps, Avalanche emphasizes low fees, EVM compatibility and scalability without sacrificing decentralization. Expect an engineering-heavy culture that values distributed systems research, ecosystem support and shipping performant chain infrastructure with academic rigor.

logos.name: Logos
logos.description: Logos is building a sovereign, privacy-preserving web stack and zero-knowledge infrastructure layer designed to protect digital rights, free expression, and financial autonomy. Logos incorporates peer-to-peer messaging (Waku), decentralized storage (Codex), and private smart contract execution (Nomos). Logos develops peer-to-peer messaging, decentralized storage, and zero-knowledge privacy infrastructure to preserve digital rights, free expression, and financial autonomy. Incorporating Waku messaging, Codex storage, and Nomos smart contract execution, Logos builds a sovereign, censorship-resistant web stack. Logos builds peer-to-peer messaging, decentralized storage, and zero-knowledge privacy infrastructure to preserve digital rights, free expression, and financial autonomy. Logos provides open-source privacy primitives that empower developers to build censorship-resistant decentralized applications.

asymmetric-research.name: Asymmetric Research
asymmetric-research.description: Asymmetric Research is a premier crypto-native security engineering, smart contract auditing, and quantitative research firm. Founded by former senior engineers and researchers from Jump Crypto, Asymmetric Research specializes in securing high-throughput layer-one blockchains, decentralized bridges, cross-chain messaging infrastructure, and complex DeFi primitives across the Solana and wider multi-chain ecosystems. The team conducts in-depth protocol reviews, formal verification, zero-day vulnerability analysis, and real-time onchain monitoring, serving as a trusted security partner for tier-one protocols and institutional digital asset builders.

busha.name: Busha
busha.description: Busha, founded in 2018 by Michael Adeyeri and Chiefy Mbama in Lagos, Nigeria, is a leading pan-African digital asset exchange and brokerage. As one of the first cryptocurrency platforms in Africa to secure official provisional regulatory approval from the Nigerian Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Busha delivers consumer trading apps, automated high-yield savings (Busha Yield), and merchant payment checkouts (Busha Commerce) tailored for emerging African economies. Backed by Jump Capital, Busha builds reliable financial bridges for millions of African consumers.

hylo.name: Hylo
hylo.description: Hylo is a high-performance decentralized automated market maker (AMM) and liquidity protocol engineered specifically for the Solana blockchain. Designed to maximize capital efficiency and minimize execution slippage for algorithmic and high-frequency traders, Hylo introduces concentrated liquidity mechanisms and dynamic fee curves optimized for Solana's sub-second block finality. Hylo provides market makers, token issuers, and retail DeFi participants with deep onchain liquidity, seamless programmatic trading APIs, and customizable yield vaults for digital assets.

fin.name: Fin
fin.description: Fin is an institutional-grade digital asset trading, settlement, and compliance infrastructure platform built for professional capital markets. Operating across low-latency decentralized networks and regulated liquidity venues, Fin provides hedge funds, proprietary trading desks, and asset managers with unified execution, deep liquidity aggregation, real-time risk controls, and automated post-trade settlement. By combining institutional custody standards with high-throughput onchain rails, Fin enables professional market participants to deploy capital into digital assets with institutional reliability and regulatory transparency.

alpen-labs.name: Alpen Labs
alpen-labs.description: Alpen Labs, founded in June 2022 by Simanta Gautam, Pramod Kandel, Chandan Sharma Subedi and Abishkar Chhetri in Brooklyn, New York, builds Bitcoin scaling infrastructure centered on Strata, a ZK rollup for Bitcoin. Its stack uses zero-knowledge proofs to extend Bitcoin with programmable smart contracts and low-cost transactions while anchoring settlement to Bitcoin security via BitVM-inspired constructions. Headquartered in Brooklyn with a research-heavy team across the US and Europe, Alpen emphasizes succinct verification, bridge minimization and developer tooling for Bitcoin-native DeFi and payments. Still advancing toward testnet and ecosystem partnerships, it contributes open research on Bitcoin interoperability and proving. Backed by Ribbit Capital and Castle Island Ventures, the team blends Bitcoin and ZK expertise. Expect a research-driven culture that values Bitcoin ethos, cryptographic rigor and building careful, verifiable extensions that respect Bitcoin's base layer guarantees.

bitso.name: Bitso
bitso.description: Bitso, founded in 2014 by Ben Peters, Daniel Vogel and Pablo Gonzalez in Mexico City, is the leading crypto exchange and cross-border payments provider for Latin America. Its platform offers spot trading, remittance and treasury rails across Mexico, Argentina, Brazil and Colombia with local bank integrations and licensed operations. Headquartered in Mexico City with hubs in Buenos Aires and São Paulo, Bitso emphasizes peso-pegged stablecoins, fast settlement and regulatory licensing in each market. Serving retail and business clients for remittances and treasury, the company bridges traditional banking with stablecoin settlement. Backed by leading investors, Bitso pioneered regulated crypto adoption in the region. Expect a regional and compliance-focused culture that values payments reliability, local partnerships and expanding accessible crypto financial services for everyday Latin American users.

bnb-chain.name: BNB Chain
bnb-chain.description: BNB Chain is a community-driven, decentralized Layer 1 blockchain ecosystem powered by BNB. Comprising BNB Smart Chain (BSC), opBNB (Layer 2), and BNB Greenfield (decentralized storage), BNB Chain serves hundreds of millions of users with high-speed, low-cost decentralized finance, Web3 gaming, and AI infrastructure.

presto-labs.name: Presto Labs
presto-labs.description: Presto Labs, founded in 2014 in Seoul and headquartered in Singapore, is a world-class algorithmic trading firm and quantitative market maker in digital assets and financial derivatives. Built by elite competitive programmers and quantitative researchers, Presto trades billions in daily volume across global cryptocurrency spot, perpetual futures, and options markets, deploying ultra-low-latency execution engines and automated statistical arbitrage strategies.

project-eleven.name: Project Eleven
project-eleven.description: Project Eleven, based in San Francisco, is an advanced cryptographic research and security engineering company developing post-quantum security layers for blockchain protocols. Led by veteran cryptographers and distributed systems engineers, Project Eleven builds quantum-resistant digital signatures, lattice-based cryptography, and zero-knowledge verification schemes to ensure Layer 1 blockchains and consensus networks remain secure against quantum computing advances.

index-industries.name: Index Industries
index-industries.description: Index Industries is a Web3 financial engineering and protocol development studio building autonomous decentralized financial primitives, on-chain index architecture, and automated smart contract yield generation engines. The team focuses on non-custodial capital efficiency, developing composable structured products and risk-adjusted yield vaults for decentralized finance ecosystems.

staking-facilities.name: Staking Facilities
staking-facilities.description: Staking Facilities is an enterprise-grade proof-of-stake validator and non-custodial staking infrastructure provider based in Munich, Germany. Securing billions in digital assets across top networks including Ethereum, Solana, Cosmos, and Polkadot, Staking Facilities operates proprietary enterprise hardware in certified European data centers with 24/7 monitoring. The company values regulatory compliance, maximum uptime, hardware security modules (HSMs), and institutional transparency. Staking Facilities operates enterprise validator hardware in certified European data centers, securing proof-of-stake networks with 24/7 monitoring and high availability.

axiom.name: Axiom
axiom.description: Axiom develops zero-knowledge proving infrastructure for developers. Its products include the modular OpenVM virtual machine and the Axiom Proving API for generating proofs of program execution.

bitmama.name: Bitmama
bitmama.description: Bitmama provides a platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies. Its services also include crypto payment cards and transfers of fiat money and digital assets.

dialectic.name: Dialectic
dialectic.description: Dialectic combines machine intelligence with crypto-native financial infrastructure. Its work includes agentic DeFi, automated yield strategies, and deep-technology venture investing.

ginco.name: Ginco
ginco.description: Ginco develops blockchain infrastructure and tools for businesses building Web3 services. Its products include an enterprise crypto wallet, wallet monitoring tools, a blockchain cloud platform, and a self-custodial mobile wallet.

sbi-vc-trade.name: SBI VC Trade
sbi-vc-trade.description: SBI VC Trade provides cryptocurrency trading services in Japan. Its products include spot and leveraged trading, crypto lending, recurring purchases, staking, and services for corporate customers.

coinmotion.name: Coinmotion
coinmotion.description: Coinmotion provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, and storage services for individuals and businesses. Its products include recurring purchases, an OTC trading desk, and an API for connecting accounts to other services.

pdax.name: PDAX
pdax.description: PDAX is a digital asset trading platform serving the Philippines. Its app provides access to cryptocurrencies, government bonds, and digital collectibles, with local cash-in and cash-out options.

foxbit.name: Foxbit
foxbit.description: Foxbit is a Brazilian cryptocurrency platform for individuals and businesses. It offers crypto trading, digital dollar services, international transfers, and a card for spending crypto balances.

finoa.name: Finoa
finoa.description: Finoa develops technology infrastructure that helps businesses participate in the onchain economy. Its infrastructure work includes blockchain and staking services; regulated financial services are handled by separately licensed entities.

taurus.name: Taurus
taurus.description: Taurus builds digital asset infrastructure for banks and other financial institutions. Its platform combines custody, tokenization, trading, and collateral management for cryptocurrencies, tokenized securities, and digital currencies.

xrex.name: XREX
xrex.description: XREX Group provides cross-border payment and cryptocurrency exchange services. It builds blockchain-based financial services for businesses and individuals.

finst.name: Finst
finst.description: Finst is a cryptocurrency exchange based in Amsterdam. Its platform offers crypto trading and investment bundles with monthly rebalancing, alongside tools for managing digital asset investments.

breet.name: Breet
breet.description: Breet provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, swapping, and cash-out services in Nigeria and Ghana. Businesses can use its crypto payment API, invoice tools, and OTC trading desk.

bit2me.name: Bit2Me
bit2me.description: Bit2Me is a Spanish cryptocurrency platform for individuals, companies, and institutions. Its products include a crypto broker, wallet, trading tools, a payment card, and tax reports, with services for buying, selling, storing, sending, and receiving digital assets.

honeycoin.name: HoneyCoin
honeycoin.description: HoneyCoin builds payment and treasury infrastructure for businesses operating across borders, including African markets. Its platform combines multi-currency wallets, virtual accounts, stablecoin conversion, and local payment collection and payouts.

dunamu.name: Dunamu
dunamu.description: Dunamu develops digital asset and securities services in South Korea. Its products include the Upbit cryptocurrency exchange and the Stockplus investment platforms, alongside blockchain services.

21bitcoin.name: 21bitcoin
21bitcoin.description: 21bitcoin provides an app for buying, saving, and holding Bitcoin. Users can make recurring purchases and choose between custody through the service and transfers to their own wallets.

aquanow.name: Aquanow
aquanow.description: Aquanow provides digital asset infrastructure and liquidity for financial institutions. Its services support digital asset brokerage, trading, and stablecoin payments through APIs, platforms, and OTC execution.

bison.name: BISON
bison.description: BISON is a cryptocurrency trading platform powered by the Boerse Stuttgart Group. Its app and website let users buy, sell, and hold Bitcoin and other cryptocurrencies.

bitcoin-suisse.name: Bitcoin Suisse
bitcoin-suisse.description: Bitcoin Suisse provides crypto finance services for individuals, corporations, and crypto organizations. Its product suite includes trading, staking, custody, and lending with dedicated client support.

bitnovo.name: Bitnovo
bitnovo.description: Bitnovo provides cryptocurrency buying, selling, and swapping services, with a self-custodial wallet. Its business products include crypto payment acceptance, on-ramp integrations, an OTC desk, and APIs.

cashlink.name: Cashlink
cashlink.description: Cashlink builds infrastructure for issuing and settling token-based securities. It provides a token-based registry and services for issuers, brokers, and financial institutions moving capital-market processes onto distributed ledgers.

change.name: Change
change.description: Change operates a multi-asset trading app that combines cryptocurrency investing with contracts for difference on stocks, foreign exchange, indices, and commodities. Users can manage these products through one platform.

coincash.name: CoinCash
coincash.description: CoinCash is a Hungarian cryptocurrency broker offering online buying, selling, and asset management. It also operates a Bitcoin ATM network and provides tailored services for larger investors.

coincorner.name: CoinCorner
coincorner.description: CoinCorner provides Bitcoin buying, selling, storage, and payment services for individuals and businesses. Its products include recurring Bitcoin purchases, international transfers, custody, and the Lightning-enabled Bolt Card.

coinext.name: Coinext
coinext.description: Coinext is a Brazilian cryptocurrency trading platform. It provides buying and selling, crypto storage and transfers, staking, and deposits and withdrawals in Brazilian reais through Pix.

coinfinity.name: Coinfinity
coinfinity.description: Coinfinity is a Bitcoin broker with an app and web portal for buying, selling, and saving in Bitcoin. Its products include recurring savings plans, an integrated wallet, and Bitcoin purchases through Lightning.

deblock.name: Deblock
deblock.description: Deblock combines a euro current account with a self-custody cryptocurrency wallet. Its app includes an IBAN, a Visa card, SEPA transfers, and tools for using euros and digital assets.

double-jump-tokyo.name: double jump.tokyo
double-jump-tokyo.description: double jump.tokyo builds enterprise Web3 infrastructure for authentication and payments. Its work includes corporate wallets, stablecoin and AI-agent payments, and cryptocurrency accounting. Its products include the N Suite enterprise wallet, RIKYU crypto accounting software, and Wallet Engine.

flitpay.name: Flitpay
flitpay.description: Flitpay is a cryptocurrency exchange serving India. Its platform lets users buy and sell Bitcoin and other digital assets in Indian rupees and transfer cryptocurrencies between platforms.

fomo-pay.name: FOMO Pay
fomo-pay.description: FOMO Pay provides digital payment and financial services for merchants, corporations, and financial institutions. Its products include payment collection, global payouts, multi-currency virtual accounts, and treasury services.

fuze.name: Fuze
fuze.description: Fuze builds digital asset payment and wealth infrastructure for banks, fintechs, and other businesses. Its platform supports stablecoin orchestration, cross-border payments, crypto payment acceptance, trading, and wallets.

hata.name: Hata
hata.description: Hata operates a cryptocurrency exchange that connects fiat money with digital assets. Its platform offers crypto buying, selling, trading, staking, and portfolio tracking.

koinx.name: KoinX
koinx.description: KoinX develops cryptocurrency tax, accounting, and portfolio tracking software. Its tools help investors, businesses, and tax professionals calculate liabilities, produce reports, and manage digital asset transactions.

lemon.name: Lemon
lemon.description: Lemon provides a digital wallet for payments, transfers, and cryptocurrency investing. Its app combines peso and digital dollar balances with Bitcoin access, investment products, and payment card features.

midchains.name: MidChains
midchains.description: MidChains provides digital asset infrastructure for institutions and corporate customers. Its services focus on trade execution, corporate treasury, and cross-border settlement and payment flows.

mt-pelerin.name: Mt Pelerin
mt-pelerin.description: Mt Pelerin provides tools for buying, selling, and swapping cryptocurrencies in self-custody. Its services include wallet-linked IBANs, crypto-funded bank transfers, and an OTC desk for larger trades.

nbx.name: NBX
nbx.description: NBX is a Norwegian cryptocurrency exchange supporting trading in Norwegian kroner. Its products include Bitcoin and other digital assets, tokenized metals, recurring investment tools, OTC trading, and custody.

netcoins.name: Netcoins
netcoins.description: Netcoins provides cryptocurrency trading services in Canada. Its platform includes instant trades, limit orders, portfolio tools, and staking, with funding through Interac e-transfers, bank wires, and crypto deposits.

paymium.name: Paymium
paymium.description: Paymium is a French platform for buying, selling, and managing cryptocurrencies. It serves individuals and businesses with recurring purchases, Bitcoin savings plans, and an OTC service for larger transactions.

relai.name: Relai
relai.description: Relai provides a Bitcoin savings app built around self-custody. Users can buy Bitcoin and manage their own private keys rather than leaving their holdings under the app provider's control.

safello.name: Safello
safello.description: Safello is a Swedish cryptocurrency brokerage. Its platform offers crypto trading, automatic savings, and wallet storage, with BankID login and Swish payments.

tangany.name: Tangany
tangany.description: Tangany provides digital asset custody infrastructure for banks, brokers, and financial institutions. Its white-label platform includes API-based wallet services and a core crypto system for integrating digital assets into financial products.

waltio.name: Waltio
waltio.description: Waltio develops cryptocurrency tax reporting software. It aggregates transactions from exchanges, wallets, and blockchains to help users organize their activity and prepare tax reports.

zumo.name: Zumo
zumo.description: Zumo provides embedded digital asset infrastructure for companies offering crypto products in the UK. Its platform supports custody, trading, customer onboarding, and localized compliance processes for financial institutions and crypto businesses.

swissquote.name: Swissquote
swissquote.description: Swissquote is a digital banking and online trading group. It offers banking and investment services across securities, currencies, derivatives, and cryptocurrencies.

ankr.name: Ankr
ankr.description: Ankr provides blockchain infrastructure for developers and businesses. Its products include multichain RPC and API access, rollup and sidechain development services, and staking integrations.

applied-blockchain.name: Applied Blockchain
applied-blockchain.description: Applied Blockchain designs and builds digital asset applications, AI systems, and privacy-preserving infrastructure. Its services include blockchain strategy, tokenization, smart contract development and review, and integration support for regulated industries.

arcus.name: Arcus
arcus.description: Arcus develops a self-custodial decentralized exchange on Robinhood Chain. Its platform focuses on tokenized stock trading and perpetual derivatives with around-the-clock market access.

argus-labs.name: Argus Labs
argus-labs.description: Argus Labs develops games and infrastructure for onchain game worlds. Its World Engine SDK uses a sharded rollup architecture to let developers build scalable, EVM-compatible blockchains for games.

arrakis-finance.name: Arrakis Finance
arrakis-finance.description: Arrakis Finance provides automated, non-custodial market making for token issuers. Its tools manage onchain liquidity for project tokens, tokenized real-world assets, and equities across decentralized trading venues.

auros.name: Auros
auros.description: Auros is a proprietary cryptocurrency trading firm and liquidity provider. It combines algorithmic trading infrastructure with market-making services and support for token launches and liquidity strategy.

bitaccess.name: Bitaccess
bitaccess.description: Bitaccess builds blockchain software for fintech businesses. Its products include Bitcoin ATM technology and the Catena suite for publishing and managing datasets on public or private blockchains.

bitonic.name: Bitonic
bitonic.description: Bitonic provides Bitcoin buying, selling, and storage services. Its app supports target-price orders and recurring investment plans, with options to use a Bitonic account or a personal wallet.

bluefin.name: Bluefin
